s.note: the long winter in the Soviet Union
s.how: Mix 100g buckwheat flour, 100g plain flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm milk and rest an hour. Cook small spoonfuls in butter until golden. Top each with sour cream, a curl of smoked salmon and dill.

Pack 1kg small cucumbers into a jar with 4 garlic cloves, dill and 1 tsp peppercorns. Pour over a cooled brine of 1L water and 50g salt. Leave on the bench for 4 days until sour. Serve with buttered rye bread.

m.note: Soviet dumplings for the training camp
m.how: Mix 300g flour, 1 egg and 125ml water into a firm dough and rest. Mix 250g beef mince, 250g pork mince and 1 grated onion. Roll the dough thin, cut rounds, fill and seal. Boil 5 minutes, toss in 50g butter and dill, serve with sour cream.

w.how: Beat 225g butter with 60g icing sugar and vanilla, then mix in 280g plain flour and 100g finely chopped walnuts. Roll into 30 balls and bake at 180C for 14 minutes. Roll in icing sugar while warm, then again when cool.

d.how: Keep a bottle of vodka and four small glasses in the freezer overnight. Pour 30ml into each glass and drink in one go, then chase it with a bite of dill pickle. One round is plenty before the fight.
